class.name: InputInvert
class.brief_description: Flips the sign of selected components.
class.description: Use on Axis, Vector, and Motion bindings. For example, flip a mouse motion binding's Y component to author inverted look. Scalar actions read X.

members.member: Invert X. This is the component read by a scalar action.
Invert Y. This affects vector and relative mouse motion values.
